text:
Jordan (CS): Hey team — quick coord for QuantumEdge Dedicated bring-up. Customer wants to run a traffic probe + ops handoff this Friday. Need quota numbers, autoscale knobs, and a short loadtest plan. Can we confirm windows and owners?

Alice (QuantumEdge): Thanks! We're aiming for a 2h probe in STAGING 09:00-11:00 UTC, then a 1h cutover in PROD 13:00-14:00 UTC. Main goal: validate burst traffic and cache priming.

Jordan (CS): Got it. Owners: @Sam for runtime config, @Maya for infra/autoscale, @Leo for load scripts/observability. I'll run the enablement doc and handoff notes.

Sam (Eng): @Jordan noted. For throughput target, QuantumEdge asked for sustained 750 rps with 95th pct token latency < 220ms. Proposed runtime settings:
```
model_variant: redwood-opt-8q
batch_window_ms: 15
max_batch_size: 64
cpu_offload: enabled
kv_cache_ttl: 3600
```
We'll also pin model version to v2026-03-12 for the test.

Maya (SRE): Autoscale plan: primary pool = qedge-dedicated-us-east. Scale policy: up at 70% GPU util for 60s, scale-down at <30% for 180s. Warmup buffer = 2 extra GPUs for 15m before probe. I'll schedule capacity reserve. Need exact quota numbers from billing to provision.

Leo (SE): Load generator script and quick command:
```
# from a k8s job
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 12m --rps 750 -e API_KEY=${QEDGE_KEY} script.js
```
Script will ramp: 0->250 in 3m, 250->500 in 4m, spike to 750 for 5m, then cool-down. Observability hooks: trace sampling=100% for the spike window.

Alice (QuantumEdge): Confirming the schedule. Also want a fallback: if 95th exceeds 350ms, don't cut to prod and run a tiered fallback (smaller batch, same model).

Sam (Eng): Good call. Add a canary route to run 10% of prod traffic to a smaller pool with batch_window_ms=8. If canary passes, proceed. Otherwise hold.

deploy-bot: [deploy] capacity-reserve qedge-dedicated-us-east +2 GPUs scheduled by Maya at 2026-06-18T08:40:00Z

Maya (SRE): Reserve created. Also enabling prefix cache priming step: run 1-hour warmup with representative prompts (Leo will supply).

Leo (SE): I'll push the prompt set to the bucket: s3://qedge-probes/warmup-v1.txt and include the K6 script in the same repo.

Sam (Eng): Quick quota check — need 48 GPU-hours reserved to hit the probe + warmup + dry runs. Jordan, can CS confirm procurement/commitment?

Jordan (CS): Alice, do you have the budget/commitment for the reserved hours? If not, we can run a scaled-down probe.

Alice (QuantumEdge): Approval is greenlighted for 48 GPU-hours. I'll send final PO by EOD. :thumbsup:

Jordan (CS): Perfect. Final checklist before Friday:
- PO received (Alice)
- Reserve +2 GPUs (Maya) ✅
- Runtime pinned (Sam) ✅
- Load script + prompts (Leo) ✅
- Canary route configured (Sam)
- Observability: trace sampling + token-level cost (Leo/Maya)

Maya (SRE): I'll set alert thresholds: 95th latency > 300ms -> pager to oncall; GPU queue length > 30 -> slack alert.

Sam (Eng): I'll create a short rollback play: switch traffic to hosted-fallback (model smaller) if latency breaches for >3 consecutive minutes.

Jordan (CS): Cool. Everyone please add any blockers by EOD. If none, we'll run the staging probe Friday 09:00 UTC.

Alice (QuantumEdge): No blockers from Ops. See you Friday.

Maya (SRE): Adding runbook note and tagging oncall.

Sam (Eng): I'll push the pinned image and post the hash in this thread before Friday.

Jordan (CS): Thanks all — I'll compile notes and send the final enablement checklist. :party-parrot:
